recipe.visualDefinition: A grotesque, hyper-exaggerated caricature of a wealthy man, characterized by extreme facial folds, a sinister grin with gold teeth, and an abundance of currency-themed accessories including money fans behind the ears and a cigar rolled from a hundred-dollar bill.
coreVisualRelationships: The subject's massive, jowly head dominates the central frame.
Currency notes act as secondary structural elements, replacing hair and cigar tobacco.
High-contrast lighting emphasizes the oily texture of the skin and the metallic sheen of jewelry.
coreInvariants: Dark, flat background to isolate the subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Extreme close-up, centered, filling 80% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and sinister expression.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the eyes, moves down to the gold-toothed mouth, follows the hand with rings to the watch, then up to the money fans behind the ears.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Solid black background provides high contrast for the warm skin tones and green currency.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm, fleshy ochre and tan for the skin tones.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black background for silhouette definition.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Currency green and metallic gold for accessories.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the dark background and the brightly lit, saturated skin and jewelry.
paletteRestrictions: Focus on earthy, fleshy tones and currency greens

letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses wide, heavy slab serifs with internal horizontal hatching.
Secondary text uses a delicate, formal copperplate script.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters in the primary title are spaced widely across the top margin.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High contrast between industrial, heavy slab serifs and elegant, delicate script.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab serif skeleton.
Matches the formal, flourished secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a grotesque airbrushed illustration of a very fat man with a sinister grin, gold teeth, and oily skin. He wears a suit, many gold rings, a diamond watch, and has fans of 100-dollar bills tucked behind his ears like hair. He is smoking a cigar made of a rolled dollar bill. Solid black background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase slab serif text across the top with wide tracking and a green hatched fill. Below it, add a small, elegant copperplate script in cream.

verificationChecks: Is the skin texture oily and highly detailed?
Are the money fans behind the ears clearly visible?
Is the primary text wide-spaced and slab-serif?

mustRedesign: Specific facial likeness to any real person
Exact currency serial numbers or portraits
Specific brand logos on the watch or suit

mustAchieve: Strong contrast between subject and background

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the gold teeth have a metallic sheen.
Verify the 'money cigar' has a glowing cherry and smoke.
Check that the slab serif text has the internal hatching pattern.
Confirm the subject's expression is sinister rather than jolly.
recipe.reuseFormula: Grotesque Caricature + Currency Symbolism + 80s Airbrush Technique + Slab/Script Typographic Pairing
